notes.title: The lots of little things update.
notes.notes: [p]Jumping Steve has changed alot over the last year.[/p][p]After the game was released, I realised it was slow to get going and boring, so i rushed to re-make it. I had to enjoy it myself, so i ended up working for upto 10 hours a day at the computer screen, Its my first game so there is a lot to learn.[/p][p]There ended up bing a lot of bugs and i was tired, so i had a break and now i'm back on track.[/p][p]The next game i do will be early access for sure.[/p][p][/p][p]NEW CHANGE LOG:[/p][p]1. Achievement box moved to the front.[/p][p]2. Fixed a recurring UI problem in Campaign[/p][p]3. Changed Campaign level 2 background colour so you can see slimes after eating the purple mushroom[/p][p]4. Change a lot of the buttons to go with the colour scheme (not final yet, the log book looks strange)[/p][p]5. Slowed down the worm holes[/p][p]6. Changed the crow spawning so it has more variety [/p][p]7. slot machine fixed so you don't lose if you hold after a win[/p][p]8. returning to save slot screen is no longer deleting the text[/p][p]9. A few other small fixes[/p][p][/p][p]WHATS THE PLAN?[/p][olist][*][p]A testing and bug fixing session over the next week (maybe two depending on how much time i have to work on it)[/p][/*][*][p]Finish the arcade score system and other scoreboard related things (like adding what controls you used, since pad is alot easier, i like to know these things.)[/p][/*][*][p]have another look into a global scoreboard (I think steam made it easier recently, but that could have been a dream)[/p][/*][*][p]Then eventually (probably while i do the other stuff because its more fun) add more mini games and challenges.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]I have also made a free game called Find The Blue Dot, It can be found on stevesgames.co.uk[/p][p][url="https://www.stevesgames.co.uk/findthebluedot/index.html"]https://www.stevesgames.co.uk/findthebluedot/index.html[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Tell your friends and social media if you have a bit of spare time.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Jumping Steve has been remade
notes.notes:
Jumping Steve has been re-made from scratch and is now playable.
I have moved the unstadle branch of the game to the Default branch.
I still have lots of testing to do but dont worry i will be working hard to fix and add things still.

2 player is VERY untested. enter or start on a second game pad for them to join and ] or back/selct to drop out.

There is now a gun but it dosent work very well with touch screens.

Next I plan on adding:
Lots of 2 player modes and mini games.
More challenges
More achievements
More campaign levels after i have finished level 1.
Sound effects that you can turn on and off.

Campaign mode is very minimal at the moment, you can play from start to finish and there is a score board.

The old vession is still avaliable on another branch but the achievements are no longer compatible just incase anyone wants to try it.  

Thanks for reading
-Steve-

notes.title: Massive Remake Update
notes.notes:
Jumping Steve has been remade and is avaliable on the unstable branch.

GOOD STUFF
Everything that was in the old version is in the new version except for a few achievements and challenges that didnt work.
you can still play the old version if you want and il keep it avaliable but eventually the achievements will not work on this version.
much better code that runs alot smoother.

BAD STUFF
At the moment Campaign mode has not been made but you can still access it and is very buggy and might ruin saves so be careful.
I have only added one steam achievement at the moment but the rest of the achievements work in the game.
shooting isnt quite right yet.
2 player works but is very very untested. classic was not designed to be 2 player and VS needs more modes and balancing.
player 2 has not been completely added to the game yet and cant do alot of stuff like pick up items.
there is still alot to do like adding challenges and balancing items.

NEW STUFF
there are 3 save slots avaliable that auto save at certain points.
scores and scoreboards work alot better.
New areas including an interactive title screen.
Guns and shooting.
more Ginger Dave.

notes.title: Im working on a massive update
notes.notes:
Hello Jeff, or whatever your name is the one person who reads this.

I am one month into a massive game update and its looking quite good so i wanted to share my plans with you Jeff.

I started the game from scratch except for a few sprites and chunks of code(im not rewriting the ingame keyboard, because it works fine and took ages).
its still the same game but made much better.

THE PLAN
So far the game has a second player, its early testing but it seems to work fine.
The game starts full of action instead of being slow and boring with the new randomisation modes, like 20 second flip mode (might change the name) where the crow settings change every 20 seconds.
A log book you can open at anytime to see your achievements, if you have a challenge active you will be able to see the requirements.
The title screen is more fun.
I am adding a Campaign mode, it is 2 player split screen, thats about all i know because im trying to finish the classic stuff before i work too much on the new stuff.

Thank you for reading, i will upload the new version to the unstable branch as soon as i have completed the classic modes.

Now that Jumping Steve is on sale i thought i should let people know what my plans are.

First of all there are still a few bugs i need to fix and probably a few small ones i haven't found yet but i think the game is very playable, most of the bugs are to do with late game stuff.
I am working on Jumping Steve every day so it shouldnt take long.

Thanks for reading, Have fun.

notes.title: Hello everyone. I am Steve and my first game is almost complete.
notes.notes:
Hello peope of steam.
My name is Steve and I have played computer games most of my life.
I recently started making computer games and while i was learning how I accidentaly started making a game that was to become Jumping Steve.
"Wow" i thought to myself, "this is actually quite fun and i would pay money for it if it had a few more things."
So i directed my focus on this game with the hope to put it on steam one day.
Well i just kept going and adding stuff and every time i learned something new i would have several new ideas for Jumping Steve.

I still have lots i want to add because i know it can be better, but i also know myself and would like to have a nice polished game before i try and go too big.

So hopefully in the next few days Jumping steve will have its debut.
I have found my passion in life and i hope you can enjoy playing this as much as i have had making it.

Thanks for reading - Steve -
